podcast.title: Musical Chemistry
podcast.body: The collaboration between Courtney Barnett and Kurt Vile on their 2017 album was marked by exceptional chemistry, where their styles "penetrated" each other seamlessly. This made them seem like a couple, even though they were not. "ellos son se encajan muy bien hasta llega un punto en que parece que sean novios lo que pasa es que no es posible pero pero es que en serio era un disco fantástico."
